about: Serious or critical axe violations that existed when the snapshot run was introduced (ANGULAR_DESIGN_SYSTEM_PLAN.md, step 5, 2 October 2026). They are existing debt in the lg-* components, not in the showcase: the run fails only on violations not listed here. Remove an entry when it is fixed.

violations.reason: An interactive ItemSlot with no name and caption=false (icon only: the Insufficient and Cooldown stories) renders a button with no accessible name. Fix when ItemSlot becomes an attribute component on button (plan step 16): require a label.
A locked item in the compact rail has no accessible name: its title is hidden in compact and only unlocked items get a title attribute. Fix with the NavRail rework (plan step 18).
The same compact NavRail problem, in the Compact rail story. Fix with the NavRail rework (plan step 18).
